tool.name: CIRI_DE
tool.description: pairwise circRNA differential expression analysis without replicates

param.name: pvalue
param.label: P value threshold for DE and DS score calculation

tool.help:
**What it does**
CIRI_DE performs pairwise circRNA differential expression (DE) and isoform switching (DS) analysis between a **case** and a **control** CIRIquant result GTF. It is intended for designs **without replicates**; for replicate designs use prep_CIRIquant followed by DESeq2/edgeR instead.
The input GTFs must have been produced with host gene abundance estimation enabled (do not use `--no-gene` in CIRIquant).
If both input GTFs carry RNase R correction statistics (i.e. they are second-pass results from the RNase R correction workflow), CIRI_DE automatically uses the RNase R corrected mode.
**Output**
The tabular output has one row per circRNA with the columns `circRNA_ID`, `Case_BSJ`, `Case_FSJ`, `Case_Ratio`, `Ctrl_BSJ`, `Ctrl_FSJ`, `Ctrl_Ratio`, `DE_score` and `DS_score`. Negative DE scores indicate lower expression in the case sample.
For further details see the [CIRI-cookbook](https://ciri-cookbook.readthedocs.io/en/latest/CIRIquant_0_home.html).
